title: Slow Down Ideas
intro: Ideas for a slower few minutes. Pick whichever sounds easy and leave the rest.

cards.back: Breathe in through your nose for a count of four and out for a count of four, at a comfortable pace. Skip this if it feels odd.
Find a plant, a tree outside or a green object, and let your eyes rest on it for a moment.
Make a warm or cool drink and take your time over the first few sips.
Close your eyes if you like and name three sounds you can hear, near and far.
Notice how your feet touch the floor, or the inside of your shoes.
Jot a worry or an idea on paper, then set it aside until later.
If you can, stand in some fresh air and watch the sky for a moment.

cards.front: Do one thing at a time
cards.back: Choose a single small task and give it your full attention until it is done.
Open and close your fingers slowly a few times, and shake your wrists loose.
Notice where they are, and let them settle a little lower.
